description.narrative:
General Objective: To increase productivity and profitability of inclusive agri-food systems, from a global green transition approach and the promotion of economic development and trade as means to overcome poverty.
Specific Objective: To sustainably increase the incomes of women and men producers through resilient production systems, inclusive agroforestry and agri-food value chains, and access to high-value markets.

Bidraget syftar till att öka produktiviteten och lönsamheten inom odlingssystem för kaffe, kakao, kardemumma och grönsaker genom att främja bevattningstjänster och erbjuda teknisk assistans till jordbrukare i Guatemala.

The contribution seeks to enhance the productivity and profitability of coffee, cocoa, cardamom, and vegetable farming systems by promoting irrigation services and providing technical assistance to farmers in Guatemala.

description.narrative:
During the period September 1st. December 31st. 2025, an intensive startup process of the Project was carried out, aimed at establishing the technical, institutional, and operational conditions necessary for effective and sustainable implementation. This process included the formalization of strategic partnerships, the installation of technical and administrative teams, the structuring of financial and operational systems within We Effect, as well as the establishment of institutional arrangements with partner organizations in the regions prioritized by the project (Currently, 13 local partners have been identified with productive potential and institutional capacities that will enable them to contribute to achieving the project's expected results).
It is relevant to mention that the public-private partnerships established in this startup phase constitute a central strategic asset of the Project. The formal coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food, with cooperation agencies, financial institutions, and actors linked to initiatives such as the Team Europe Initiative (Inclusive Economic Development) contributes to generating technical and financial synergies, and positions the Project within a broader ecosystem of investment in climate resilience and inclusive rural development. Likewise, the strategic relationship that has been developed with Swedish organizations that are members of We Effect such as Folksam, Lantbrukarnas Riksförbund (LRF), and Open Trade Gate Sweden (OTGS) strengthens the possible coherence of the Project with Sweden development cooperation policy and the reform agenda of the Swedish Government, which is oriented toward results, sustainability, and partnerships with the private sector and membership based organizations.
In terms of project governance, We Effect established an Advisory Council as a technical body for consultation, strategic coordination, and the generation of synergies. This platform will facilitate the exchange of information and best practices. The Council will initially be composed of those organizations that have formalized agreements or memoranda of understanding with We Effect, and it will be supported by multidisciplinary teams of experts drawn from partner entities or hired externally to provide specialized knowledge in irrigation systems, water management, value chains, and organizational development. The creation of this platform represents a strategic element for consolidating a structured collaboration ecosystem, where public, private, and cooperation actors can coordinate investments, share lessons learned, and build a common vision for development. This governance mechanism strengthens the sustainability of the Project, improves the technical quality of interventions, and expands its potential for scaling up in the medium term.
